description: Live Kafka feed (grafana_data_orion_derived + car_status), the same stream Trackside reads. Derived-feed history fills from page open; car state history is backfilled.

panels.description: cells_temps[i] from 0x100 (23 frames x 4, 0.1 C), 1 Hz on CAN. Bars at 0 are sensors with no data. Index = position in cells_temps.
panels.title: Cell temperatures, latest per cell

panels.description: Minimum over non-zero cells. The bridge's min_cell_temp counts empty slots as 0, so it is not used.
panels.title: Coldest active cell

panels.description: Non-zero entries of 92.
panels.title: Active temp sensors

panels.description: cells_v[i] from 0x0D0 (33 frames x 4, 0.1 mV), 1 Hz on CAN. Taps under 1 V (empty slots, dead tap 16) are hidden. Colour bands are generic Li-ion limits.
panels.title: Cell voltages, latest per cell

panels.description: BMS max - min, 0x136 Battery Cell Limits.
panels.title: Spread

panels.description: Taps at or above 1 V of 132 (123 on 2026-10-10). A drop means a tap went dead.
panels.title: Active taps

panels.description: 0x136 min_cell_voltage / max_cell_voltage (BMS-computed).
panels.title: BMS min / max cell voltage, last 5 min

panels.description: 0x0A0 module A/B/C + gate driver, 0x0A2 coolant / hotspot / motor.
panels.title: Inverter & motor temperatures

panels.description: torque_request 0x0C0 (VCU to inverter), commanded_torque / torque_feedback 0x0AC.
panels.title: Torque

panels.description: Inverter dc_bus_v (0x0A7) x dc_bus_current (0x0A6), the same power the VCU power limiter holds. Shown in W, scaled to kW.
panels.title: DC bus power

panels.description: car_status topic (2 s heartbeat).
panels.title: Car state

panels.description: car_status classifier: run_faults / post_faults nonzero, imd_isolation, bmb_comm_error, shutdown_open (a leg open while HV is live).
panels.title: Active faults

panels.description: 0x0AB uint32 bitmasks; decode bits with the inverter manual.
panels.title: Inverter faults

panels.description: Count of APPS / BPPS / BSE flags set (can_bitfields.csv). Which ones: see the history below.
panels.title: Pedal sensor faults

panels.description: PDU LV Battery frame 0x183 (lv_batt_v). Orion sends no LV state of charge; voltage is the proxy.
panels.title: LV battery voltage

panels.description: PDU 0x183: lv_batt_v (left, V) and lv_batt_c (right, A).
panels.title: LV battery voltage & current

panels.description: VCU firmware power_limit_w (lhre-2026 default_params.h, all event modes). A constant: the VCU does not send it on CAN.
panels.title: Power limit

panels.description: VCU PowerLimit.c: inverter dc_bus_v (0x0A7) x dc_bus_current (0x0A6) / 1000, the power the limiter acts on.
panels.title: HV power (DC bus)

panels.description: Power limit - HV power (DC bus). Below 0: over the limit.
panels.title: Headroom

panels.description: Largest torque cut by the power limit in the last 5 min: torque_lookup - torque_power_limited (VCU 0x1CA). Over 0.5 Nm = LIMITING.
panels.title: Power limiter (5 min)

panels.description: Largest torque cut by the low-cell-voltage derate in the last 5 min: torque_lookup - torque_derated (VCU 0x1CA; starts at 3.2 V/cell).
panels.title: Low-cell derate (5 min)

panels.description: torque_limit the VCU sends the inverter (0x0C0).
panels.title: Inverter torque limit

panels.description: VCU PowerLimit.c: inverter dc_bus_v (0x0A7) x dc_bus_current (0x0A6). Red line: the 70 kW VCU power limit.
panels.title: HV power vs limit

panels.description: Headroom (left, kW) and the torque the power limit and the low-cell derate take away (right, Nm).
panels.title: Headroom & limiter torque cut

title: Live Cells, Inverter & Faults - Orion (Real-time)
